quarterly_data.signal: Capacity / capex (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): production output 67 descum/reflow tools in H1 2026 at the Hwaseong Dongtan headquarters plant (104 in all of FY2025, 156 in FY2024) - H1 2026 already 64% of last year's unit count; the company builds to order and states that stated capacity correlates poorly with output, so no capacity or utilisation figure is reported. Sites: Hwaseong (Dongtan HQ) and Pyeongtaek plants in Korea, SEMIgear in Round Rock, Texas; a Pangyo R&D campus was financed in 2023-24 (KRW 32.1B of treasury-share sales, KRW 24,000M mortgage to KDB/Shinhan). H1 PP&E additions only KRW 1,343M (construction-in-progress KRW 667M; PP&E book value KRW 67,126M) - capex is not the constraint. RAW MATERIALS (H1 purchases): plasma-source generators (RF supply for the plasma source) KRW 6,969M (12.1% of purchases) and wafer-transfer robots KRW 2,794M (4.9%), sourced from the US, Japan and Korea; the key-component price index (plasma generator + TM robot + chuck) rose to KRW 80,134K from KRW 64,534K in FY2025 (+24%), attributed to FX (USD/JPY imports) and semiconductor-market supply/demand. Supplier-finance programme with Hana Bank (25-55 day terms, zero balance). Headcount 145 (135 permanent) at 2026-06-30. quarterly_data.signal: Products / R&D pipeline / corporate events (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): three product lines - DESCUM (plasma removal of post-litho photoresist scum, which sets RDL profile and bump shape), FLUXLESS REFLOW (SEMIgear GENEVA: melting solder bumps/balls without flux, incl. chip-on-wafer bonding reflow; PSK Holdings pays SEMIgear an 8-10% royalty on GENEVA sales to Korean customers) and HOT DI WATER systems. AI framing in the filing: HBM demand is 'exploding' and advanced-packaging adoption is accelerating, so back-end equipment investment centred on high-density and STACKING processes is expected to keep expanding; strategy includes AI-enabled tool development and tool-to-tool matching platforms. R&D spend KRW 5,411M in H1 (7.2% of sales); 212 patents registered / 112 pending. ACTIVE PROJECTS: HAR (high-aspect-ratio) descum process and tool (since 2024-07); ABF DESMEAR process (since 2024-12, substrate application); 3D DESCUM CHAMBER for fine-pitch bump gaps - surface treatment and flux removal between stacked dies (since 2025-03, Ministry of Science and ICT funded); H2 PLASMA REFLOW (since 2025-09); VERONA II new-application platform (since 2025-01) and VERONA II 600 for 600x600mm panels/FOPLP (since 2026-01); ECOLITE II PF (since 2025-04); ECOLITE II 400 CIP for 380mm ring-frame wafers (since 2025-09); Single Chamber reflow with fast-ramp heater chuck (since 2024-05, MSIT funded); Plasma Monitor arc detection (since 2023-04); MILANO II reflow (since 2022-11); a government-funded plasma tool for FAN-OUT packaging descum/surface treatment ran 2022-05 to 2026-06. Completed 2025-03: ECOLITE II 400 Lower-RF process for HYBRID BONDING (SiO2 surface activation, Cu-sputter defect reduction), PROLITE 12-inch descum, ECOLITE XPL 600x600mm panel descum. A laser product group (ATD G) sits in the SE Center. Corporate: credit rating A+ from e-Credible (2026-04-17); AGM 2026-03-30 re-elected CEO Park Kyung-soo (30.05% holder), elected daughter Park Yeon-kyung inside director (promoted EVP 2026-04-01; sister Park Jin-kyung promoted vice-president), Yang Jae-kyun resigned; no new business approved in the period; share price ranged KRW 49,000 (Jan 2026) to KRW 160,000 (June 2026), H1 TSR 245.57%; 2025 tax audit assessments KRW 634M + 77M paid.
quarterly_data.figure: Pipeline: 3D descum chamber for fine-pitch stacked bumps, HAR descum, ABF desmear, H2 plasma reflow, hybrid-bonding surface activation, 600x600 panel tools; R&D 7.2% of sales; rating A+ (04-17-2026); AGM 03-30-2026 board changes
